    Right almost split maps in FDMod k A #

    IsRightAS g: g : E ⟶ Z is not a split epimorphism, and every map into Z that is not a split epimorphism factors through g. Over a finite-dimensional algebra, every object with local endomorphism ring has one (FDMod.exists_rightAS).
